name: Moonbrook
summary: In southwestern Westfall, Moonbrook lies under Defias control, its streets emptied of peaceful residents. The Brotherhood uses the town as a guarded screen for its hidden headquarters in the Deadmines.

sections.title: A Fallen Town
sections.body: Before the First War, Moonbrook stood at the heart of Westfall’s breadbasket, supporting farming families and the gold shafts of the Deadmines. The Old Horde razed the town, but it was rebuilt after the Second War. Its peace did not last. The House of Nobles in Stormwind neglected the settlement, and its military protection was stripped away. Unable to resist the red-masked bandits, Moonbrook’s people were driven from their homes. Citizens and teachers fled toward Sentinel Hill and Elwynn Forest.

sections.title: Defias Stronghold
sections.body: Moonbrook’s streets and ransacked homes are patrolled by red-masked thugs and rogue wizards. Harvest golems roam the fields around town. At the edge of Moonbrook, an unassuming barn hides an entrance to the Deadmines beneath it. The Brotherhood guards the town above its tunnels, where rebellion against Stormwind is being prepared.

aliases: why are there bandits in moonbrook
faq.answer: Moonbrook’s peaceful residents fled when the Defias Brotherhood seized control of Westfall. With no Stormwind Army garrison in the region, the townsfolk were forced out and the bandits took over the town.

faq.q: Where does the mine inside Moonbrook lead?
faq.answer: The mine entrance beneath the barn at Moonbrook’s edge leads into the Deadmines. Once a vast source of gold for Stormwind, its tunnels now shelter the Defias Brotherhood and serve as their staging ground.

faq.q: Who used to live here before the bandits?
faq.answer: Miners, farmers, and tradespeople once lived in Moonbrook and supported Westfall’s agriculture. Stalvan Mistmantle briefly led the local Moonbrook Schoolhouse before the bandits overran the town.

faq.q: Does Stormwind plan to reclaim the town?
aliases: why doesn't the army help moonbrook
faq.answer: Stormwind’s court has repeatedly refused to send royal troops to free Moonbrook and the surrounding farms, saying its resources are stretched thin. The volunteer People’s Militia at Sentinel Hill is left to defend the area.

angles.text: For the Alliance, Moonbrook is a bitter reminder of the kingdom’s neglect, where law-abiding subjects were left to face the Defias Brotherhood alone.
As a Rogue, you can see in Moonbrook’s alleys and ransacked homes an outlaw syndicate operating in broad daylight.
